items.text: What a review actually looks like here: bring your card, your plan letter, and a list of your doctors and medications. We check those against what is offered. No presentation, no pressure, and often no change. honorbrook-insurance.com

People are wary of booking an insurance appointment, and they are right to be. So here is exactly what happens at ours.

You bring three things. Your Medicare card, the letter your plan sends in the autumn describing what is changing, and a list of your doctors and your medications with dosages. That is the whole preparation.

We check your specific medications against the drug lists, by name and dose, and your specific doctors against the current networks, calling practices where the directory is ambiguous. Then we tell you what we found. If nothing meaningful changed, we say so and you leave with the plan you came in with.

What does not happen: a presentation, a comparison of products you did not ask about, or a follow-up call you did not agree to. If you want to think about it, that is the end of the conversation until you get back in touch.

We are independent and licensed in 11 states, based in Tysons. Our National Producer Number is 21370662 if you would like to verify it first.

Honorbrook Insurance. honorbrook-insurance.com

We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
